evidence.title: Accessibility tree
evidence.description: Roles, accessible names, and keyboard-reachability for every node, captured after the surface settles.
evidence.notes: The load-bearing evidence channel and the reason the contract is portable across platforms: every OS exposes an equivalent tree, so an ARIA-shaped claim is checkable on native targets too.

evidence.title: Layout box
evidence.description: Position and size of a bound element in viewport coordinates.
evidence.notes: Rides along with ax-tree but is not always populated — the three live `claim_unverifiable` warnings for spacing and size-parity are all missing bounds rather than missing nodes. Modeled separately so that distinction is expressible.

evidence.title: Computed style
evidence.description: Resolved CSS values for a bound element: colors, dimensions, typography, border, shadow, and transition properties.

producer.detail: computed style read alongside the accessibility snapshot

evidence.notes: The single highest-leverage gap in the system. Its absence is why contrast, spacing conformance, typography, ramp checking, and motion duration verification are all unprovable today, and why `hover-state-contrast` reports unverifiable rather than passing or failing.

evidence.title: Screenshot
evidence.description: Rendered pixels for a capture target.
evidence.notes: Already produced by ui/scripts/preview-e2e.mjs and by ui-health's visualhealth analyzer, but never joined to experience evidence. Wiring is a plumbing problem, not a capture problem.

evidence.title: Console and page errors
evidence.description: Console output and uncaught errors emitted while the capture target rendered.

producer.detail: console and pageerror listeners during execution

evidence.notes: Needed to prove that an error state is a designed state rather than a crash — a surface that renders its error UI while also throwing is not honestly in the error state.

evidence.title: Capture and transition timing
evidence.description: How long the surface took to settle, and the measured duration of an observed transition.
evidence.notes: Settle timing already persists through CaptureTargetTiming. Per-transition measurement — what a motion-duration claim needs to verify a transition actually ran at its declared token — does not exist yet.
